Two related Udacity AWS machine-learning projects: training and operationalization.

Taking an image classifier into the cloud

Dog-breed classification used to practice training, tuning, serving and operating a cloud ML endpoint.

PyTorch · ResNet50 · Amazon SageMaker · AWS Lambda · EC2 · S3

The question

Model development and model operation need a connected workflow.

The work

  • Train and tune a ResNet-based classifier with SageMaker.
  • Use debugger and profiler tooling to inspect training.
  • Compare SageMaker and EC2 training paths and invoke a deployed endpoint through Lambda.
  • Explore endpoint autoscaling, Lambda concurrency and access-policy tradeoffs.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Includes an original training-to-deployment architecture diagram and cloud training/inference implementation.

Inside the collection

Image Classification using AWS SageMaker

Train, tune, debug and deploy a dog-breed classifier.

Operationalizing an AWS ML Project

Explore EC2 training, Lambda invocation, autoscaling, concurrency and access policies.

What I learned

  • A functioning endpoint also needs capacity planning, monitoring and carefully scoped access.

Project context

  • Coursework environment; no production uptime or security certification claim.
  • Cloud-console screenshots were omitted to avoid account and resource identifiers.
